title: Walk Until a Song Ends
description: Pick the longest song you own, start walking, and turn back when it stops.

title: Stretch Whatever Aches
description: Find the stiffest part of you and lean into it slowly for a minute. No heroics, no floor required.

title: Dance Badly in the Kitchen
description: One song, the worst moves you have, nobody filming. Sitting down and moving your arms counts.

title: Carry It All at Once
description: Whatever needs moving to another room, take it in one trip; waddling is allowed.

title: Sit on the Floor for Ten Minutes
description: No chair. Shift position whenever it gets uncomfortable; the shifting is the exercise.

title: Walk Up Something and Look Down
description: Find the highest ground you can reach on foot, get to the top of it, and photograph whatever you can see from there. Stop early if your legs say so; the view from halfway is also a view.
